Pink Popcorn
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 3:17am

Ingredients




3 tablespoons butter
cup miniature marshmallow
4 tablespoons strawberry jello ½ package
2 quarts popcorn popped

Preparation

1 In a medium saucepan, melt butter over low heat. Stir marshmallows into the melting butter. Let them soften but not melt completely. Add the gelatin. Stir until butter-marshmallow mixture is evenly colored. Gelatin does not have to be dissolved. Drizzle over popcorn & mix well. 2 Description: "This is traditional for me to make for my Girl Scouts on the first night of camping. My daughter-in-law (who joined my Brownie troop when she was 6) still begs me for this!" Yield: 2 quarts 3 NOTES : Very pretty & pink. I've tried this in other flavors but keep coming back to the strawberry. 4 Deirdre Dee
